name: hair-clip-project
description: Parametric PETG honeycomb hair-clip family with a captured print-in-place rotational hinge

scripts.test: npm run build:presets && python3 validate_stl.py output-r6-final/large/masculine-honeycomb-hair-clip-r6-large.stl --expect-components 2 --output validation/r6-final-audits/mesh-large.json && python3 validate_stl.py output-r6-final/large/hair-clip-hinge-latch-coupon-r6.stl --expect-components 2 --output validation/r6-final-audits/mesh-coupon.json && python3 validate_3mf.py output-r6-final/large/masculine-honeycomb-hair-clip-r6-large.3mf --output validation/r6-final-audits/3mf-large.json
